data.narrative:
Steady Energy is a Series G climate and energy company founded by Tommi Nyman, Hannes Haapalahti, and Petteri Tenhunen. The company has raised €32M to date. The broader Climate & Energy sector includes eight private peers (Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, Enovix among them) and one public comparable (LNZA), though none of these peers operate at an identical stage or valuation tier that would support a robust peer-median analysis.

Given the absence of sufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables, stage-progression methodology provides the primary valuation anchor. Applying a 1.25x step-up multiplier—typical for Series G advancement—to the €32M total capital raised yields an implied valuation of €40M. This method assumes the company's future funding round will reflect standard late-stage advancement dynamics in the climate-tech sector.

The analysis triangulates to a range of €34M–€46M, with a median of €40M. This narrow band reflects reliance on a single quantitative method rather than convergence across multiple approaches. The key uncertainty remains the absence of precise peer comparables; a more robust valuation would require either identification of nearer-term Series G or H-stage climate-tech comps or disclosure of current financial metrics (revenue, unit economics, capital efficiency) that could anchor an earnings or cash-flow multiple approach.
